name: build-with-ai
description: The Build with AI course helper: plan, build, check and publish a browser app one session at a time, in plain language.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a business problem into a published web app, one class session at a time.
interface.longDescription: One command per course stage asks you the questions that matter about your product while the agent does all technical work the same way for everyone. Every session ends with a live page on GitHub Pages, a journal entry in your own words and a saved version in your project's history.
defaultPrompt: $setup Get my course folder ready and publish my first page.
$resume Turn my placeholder page into my resume website.
$ideate Help me find two project ideas from my own experience.
$plan Turn my chosen idea into a plan.
$build Build the prototype from our team's plan at <owner>/<name>.
$iterate Improve our app from the latest feedback.
$ship Finish our app and prepare the pitch.
